evals.name: Startup Schema Validation & Fail-Fast Boot Gate
evals.prompt: Implement a configuration loader for a backend app that validates PORT, DATABASE_URL, and JWT_SECRET on boot, crashing with an informative diagnostic error if any are invalid.
evals.expected_output: Defines a strict schema (e.g. Zod or Pydantic), parses environment variables during bootstrap, and aborts process execution with code 1 upon validation failure.
assertions: Defines explicit schema validation covering all mandatory environment variables
Executes validation during bootstrap prior to opening database pools or HTTP listeners
Logs structured error identifying missing or malformed variables upon validation failure
Immediately terminates process with exit code 1 to prevent invalid runtime states

evals.name: Centralized Config Service & Scattered Access Refactoring
evals.prompt: Audit a service that accesses 'process.env.DATABASE_URL' and refactor it to consume a centralized, strongly-typed configuration service.
evals.expected_output: Replaces raw process.env calls with an injected ConfigService instance providing compile-time type safety.
assertions: Eliminates raw process.env or os.environ calls inside business logic and services
Encapsulates configuration access behind a typed ConfigService singleton or injectable
Enforces type coercion for numeric ports and boolean operational flags
Enables straightforward mocking of configuration values during unit testing

evals.name: .env.example Parity, Junior Comments & Secrets Hygiene
evals.prompt: Audit a backend project's .env.example file, ensure 1:1 variable parity with required configuration, add junior-friendly setup comments, and verify gitignore rules.
evals.expected_output: Creates or updates .env.example with descriptive comments for every variable, ensures no real credentials are leaked, and verifies .env is gitignored.
assertions: Ensures every variable consumed by the application is mirrored in .env.example
Adds 3-point documentation (purpose, format, local source) above each variable
Replaces real credentials with safe placeholder strings like 'your_api_key_here'
Verifies that .env files containing live credentials are listed in .gitignore
